c01.resolution: Re-rendered both icons with the HRP LOGO MARK ONLY (no tagline) centered in the inner 60% maskable safe zone. Background kept as #ffffff (matching manifest.background_color). c01.paddingRule: Inner safe zone = 60% of canvas. Padding = (canvas - innerSize)/2 on each side. For 192×192: inner=115px, pad=38px each side. For 512×512: inner=307px, pad=102px each side.
c01.compositionRule: Source logo mark scaled with min(scaleX, scaleY) so aspect ratio is preserved. Centered within inner safe zone. Background pure white (#ffffff).
